fixtures.title: Connected letterforms
fixtures.checks: Letters must join (initial/medial/final forms), not appear as isolated letters.

fixtures.title: Lam-alef ligature
fixtures.meaning: The total does not include tax
fixtures.checks: Lam followed by alef (لا, لإ) must form the mandatory lam-alef ligature.

fixtures.title: Harakat (vowel marks)
fixtures.checks: Shadda, sukun, tanween and short vowels must sit on their base letters, not float or show dotted circles.

fixtures.title: Mixed bidi invoice line
fixtures.checks: Unicode Bidi Algorithm with an RTL paragraph: Latin and numbers keep their left-to-right order, Arabic runs right-to-left, nothing is reversed.

fixtures.title: Arabic-Indic and Persian digits
fixtures.checks: Arabic-Indic (١٢٣) and Persian (۶۷۸) digits render as digits, read left-to-right inside the RTL line.

fixtures.title: Persian letters (ی ک پ گ, ZWNJ)
fixtures.meaning: Pro-forma invoice of goods for the dear customer
fixtures.checks: Persian yeh (ی) and keheh (ک) join correctly; the zero-width non-joiner in پیش‌فاکتور breaks the join without showing a box.

fixtures.title: Hebrew with numbers
fixtures.meaning: Tax invoice 1234 for the amount of 250 ₪
fixtures.checks: Hebrew runs right-to-left, the numbers stay left-to-right and in the right place.

fixtures.title: Line wrapping
fixtures.text: شكرا لتسوقكم معنا. المنتجات المستعملة لا تسترجع.
fixtures.meaning: Thank you for shopping with us. Used products cannot be returned.
fixtures.checks: Text wraps inside a box of wrapWidth units into two lines (the break point is the same even with ±15% width differences): the first four words on line one, each line right-to-left, the full stop at the left end.
